material.description: From hy3d's live check: the abaddon hero shows a blank HUD (no abilities), so abaddon_aphotic_shield, death_coil and frostmourne could not be tested; abyssal_underlord_firestorm shows nothing either. Likely the hero ability rows are missing or unmapped in the data (abilities_688g_b*.osd or units_heroes.osd), not confirmed. Check each: is the ability listed on the hero, does it have an icon, an effect, a target; compare with the 6.88g ability rows (scenarios/moba/abilities_688g_*.osd, the effects are UNVERIFIED for hero abilities as recorded). Fix a missing link; report anything 6.88g does not supply as UNVERIFIED, not filled from Dota 2. Ownership: scenarios/moba/units_heroes.osd, abilities*.osd (data only). Acceptance: each of these heroes shows its abilities in the HUD data (the ability bar entries exist); CI green on ci and pages.

notes.note: 2026-10-25 12:20Z hy3d live witness: luna's HUD also lists no abilities, the same gap as abaddon and abyssal_underlord. Hero abilities are missing from the HUD in this build for at least three heroes.

material.subject: Abaddon's abilities (aphotic shield, death coil, frostmourne) and abyssal underlord's firestorm show nothing in the HUD
material.witness: Premise refuted on the origin tree (ec56ab6e, read via gh api contents raw): units_heroes.osd has one unit("abaddon") and one unit("abyssal_underlord") row each, with unit_extra; abilities_688g_b01.osd and b02.osd define all 8 named abilities exactly once and attach them with hero_abilities for both heroes. The blank-HUD cause (no unit row, no ability rows) no longer holds. The HUD render is browser-only and was not run (no browser verbs here), so the on-page check remains for the browser lane; effects stay UNVERIFIED where 6.88g is silent, as the files record.
